doc.brief: The QWizard class provides a framework for wizards.

QAbstractButton * button(QWizard::Wizard.brief: Returns the button corresponding to role *which*.

QList<int> pageIds() const.brief: Returns the list of page IDs.

QList<int> visitedIds() const.brief: Returns the list of IDs of visited pages, in the order in which the pages were visited.

QPixmap pixmap(QWizard::WizardPixmap whi.brief: Returns the pixmap set for role *which*.

QVariant field(const QString &name) cons.brief: Returns the value of the field called *name*.

QWidget * sideWidget() const.brief: Returns the widget on the left side of the wizard or `nullptr`.

QWizard(QWidget *parent, Qt::WindowFlags.brief: Constructs a wizard with the given *parent* and window *flags*.

QWizard::WizardOptions options() const.brief: This property holds the various options that affect the look and feel of the wizard

QWizard::WizardStyle wizardStyle() const.brief: This property holds the look and feel of the wizard

QWizardPage * currentPage() const.brief: Returns a pointer to the current page, or `nullptr` if there is no current page (e.g., before the wizard is shown).

QWizardPage * page(int id) const.brief: Returns the page with the given *id*, or `nullptr` if there is no such page.

Qt::TextFormat subTitleFormat() const.brief: This property holds the text format used by page subtitles

Qt::TextFormat titleFormat() const.brief: This property holds the text format used by page titles

bool hasVisitedPage(int id) const.brief: Returns `true` if the page history contains page *id*; otherwise, returns `false`.

bool testOption(QWizard::WizardOption op.brief: Returns `true` if the given *option* is enabled; otherwise, returns false.

bool validateCurrentPage().brief: This virtual function is called by [QWizard](xref:qt:QWizard) when the user clicks **Next** or **Finish** to perform some last-minute validation.

int addPage(QWizardPage *page).brief: Adds the given *page* to the wizard, and returns the page's ID.

int currentId() const.brief: This property holds the ID of the current page

int nextId() const.brief: This virtual function is called by [QWizard](xref:qt:QWizard) to find out which page to show when the user clicks the **Next** button.

int startId() const.brief: This property holds the ID of the first page

void back().brief: Goes back to the previous page.

void cleanupPage(int id).brief: This virtual function is called by [QWizard](xref:qt:QWizard) to clean up page *id* just before the user leaves it by clicking **Back** (unless the [QWizard::IndependentPages](xref:qt:QWizard) option...

void currentIdChanged(int id).brief: This signal is emitted when the current page changes, with the new current *id*.

void customButtonClicked(int which).brief: This signal is emitted when the user clicks a custom button. *which* can be [CustomButton1](xref:qt:QWizard), [CustomButton2](xref:qt:QWizard), or [CustomButton3](xref:qt:QWizard).

void helpRequested().brief: This signal is emitted when the user clicks the **Help** button.

void initializePage(int id).brief: This virtual function is called by [QWizard](xref:qt:QWizard) to prepare page *id* just before it is shown either as a result of [QWizard::restart](xref:qt:QWizard)() being called, or as a result of...

void pageAdded(int id).brief: This signal is emitted whenever a page is added to the wizard.

void pageRemoved(int id).brief: This signal is emitted whenever a page is removed from the wizard.

void removePage(int id).brief: Removes the page with the given *id*.

void restart().brief: Restarts the wizard at the start page.

void setButton(QWizard::WizardButton whi.brief: Sets the button corresponding to role *which* to *button*.

void setButtonLayout(const QList<QWizard.brief: Sets the order in which buttons are displayed to *layout*, where *layout* is a list of [WizardButton](xref:qt:QWizard)s.

void setButtonText(QWizard::WizardButton.brief: Sets the text on button *which* to be *text*.

void setCurrentId(int id).brief: Sets [currentId](xref:qt:QWizard) to *id*, without visiting the pages between [currentId](xref:qt:QWizard) and *id*.

void setDefaultProperty(const char *clas.brief: Sets the default property for *className* to be *property*, and the associated change signal to be *changedSignal*.

void setField(const QString &name, const.brief: Sets the value of the field called *name* to *value*.

void setOption(QWizard::WizardOption opt.brief: Sets the given *option* to be enabled if *on* is true; otherwise, clears the given *option*.

void setOptions(QWizard::WizardOptions o.brief: This property holds the various options that affect the look and feel of the wizard

void setPage(int id, QWizardPage *page).brief: Adds the given *page* to the wizard with the given *id*.

void setPixmap(QWizard::WizardPixmap whi.brief: Sets the pixmap for role *which* to *pixmap*.

void setSideWidget(QWidget *widget).brief: Sets the given *widget* to be shown on the left side of the wizard.

void setStartId(int id).brief: This property holds the ID of the first page

void setSubTitleFormat(Qt::TextFormat fo.brief: This property holds the text format used by page subtitles

void setTitleFormat(Qt::TextFormat forma.brief: This property holds the text format used by page titles

void setWizardStyle(QWizard::WizardStyle.brief: This property holds the look and feel of the wizard
